messages.author: b3204700228e4afb
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] rstan 2.1 in windows 7
parts:
YES, that's the case. I found that the older R library sub-folder "C:\R\...\library\rstan\libs\i386" was not removed. So I manually deleted the the rstan library folder "C:\R\...\library\rstan". After that, rstan compiled correctly and successfully installed.

I still have the same problem with the cmd 2.1.0 stan under XP when making a program even when I added BIT=32 as suggested by Dr. Lee (You need to add the BIT=32 flag to the command in order to make it work).

Z.
